title: Clinical T staging accuracy and its prognostic relevance in oral squamous cell carcinoma
html: Accurate clinical T-staging is essential for guiding surgical management in oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC), particularly when determining treatment escalation or de-escalation. This study evaluated its diagnostic accuracy and impact on potential over- and undertreatment. This retrospective single-center study included patients with histologically confirmed OSCC who underwent primary surgical resection with negative margins between 2012 and 2022. Clinical T-staging based on preoperative contrast-enhanced computed tomography and clinical examination was compared with pathological staging.
